pages.title: Evanston, IL Used Appliance Pickup Requests | Eligibility Review
pages.description: Submit an Evanston, Illinois used appliance pickup eligibility request with working condition, address and access details. No free collection or local route is guaranteed.
pages.local_context: Evanston handles appliance disposal separately from ordinary bulky rubbish collection. Residents can ask Evanston 311 about city-arranged appliance removal; the city says these items are not included in regular bulk limits. Our form is different: we assess whether a reusable washer, dryer, refrigerator or stove might qualify for collection by an independently approved operator, if one becomes available. This page does not claim a crew works in Evanston.
pages.access_guidance: Evanston residents in multifamily and condominium buildings should check their building rules before requesting any bulky-appliance move. Tell us whether the machine is in a basement, upstairs apartment or ground-floor utility room; note stair turns, doorway clearance and whether a lift, loading bay or alley can actually be used. The city's condo refuse arrangements vary with building participation, so never assume an appliance can be left with routine bins.
pages.condition_guidance: For laundry sets, test the washer's fill, drain and spin functions and the dryer's tumble and heat; describe gas versus electric dryers. For refrigerators and freezers, tell us whether each compartment cools and whether shelves, seals or doors are damaged. For a stove, report fuel type, burner and oven operation. Fully working units are prioritized; repairable or nonworking units need individual review and are not automatically approved for free pickup.
pages.official_resource_note: The City of Evanston describes ordinary bulk waste separately from appliances and directs residents to call or contact 311 to arrange appliance removal. For a privately managed condominium or apartment building, confirm eligible city service and access rules with property management or 311 before placing anything outside. The city program is independent of our request process, and any price, eligibility and collection appointment must be confirmed directly with the city.
